FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: FXsec07R01
Before completing a left turn, allow opposing vehicles, bicycles and pedestrians approaching from that direction to go first [FXsec07R01].
Why it matters: group yield-rules; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F02 [FXsec07R01].
Source: [FXsec07R01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: FXsec07R02
At a marked crossing or unmarked intersection, let pedestrians cross. Entry from a private driveway or road adds a required stop before yielding to all traffic and pedestrians [FXsec07R02].
Why it matters: group yield-rules; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F01 [FXsec07R02].
Source: [FXsec07R02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: FXsec07R03
At an unsigned, unsignaled intersection reached simultaneously, the driver to the left yields to the driver to the right [FXsec07R03].
Why it matters: group yield-rules; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F04 [FXsec07R03].
Source: [FXsec07R03 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: FXsec07R04
Red-light turns are particularly hazardous for pedestrians. Yield to people walking or cycling across marked crosswalks or unmarked intersections and let them cross safely [FXsec07R04].
Why it matters: group yield-rules; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F05 [FXsec07R04].
Source: [FXsec07R04 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A01
Active sirens and lights demand pulling over, stopping, and waiting, while stopped flashers demand only a lane move or a safe slowdown [A01].
Why it matters: group emergency-response; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F06, sec07-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: FXsec07R06
Pedestrians and bicyclists crossing at an unmarked intersection or in a marked crosswalk have priority over your vehicle [FXsec07R06].
Why it matters: group ped-signals; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F08 [FXsec07R06].
Source: [FXsec07R06 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: FXsec07R07
Roundabout entry yields to every circulating lane, while circulating means counterclockwise travel, signed lane choice, and a right-turn exit [FXsec07R07].
Why it matters: group roundabouts; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F09, sec07-F10 [FXsec07R07].
Source: [FXsec07R07 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: FXsec07R08
Keep your current lane inside a roundabout until you are prepared to exit [FXsec07R08].
Why it matters: group roundabouts; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F10 [FXsec07R08].
Source: [FXsec07R08 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: FXsec07R09
Check mirrors for approaching traffic, signal your lane change, then make a brief shoulder check for a vehicle in the blind spot before moving [FXsec07R09].
Why it matters: group lane-moves; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec07-F11 [FXsec07R09].
Source: [FXsec07R09 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: FXsec07R10
After passing, return once the front of the passed vehicle is visible in the rearview mirror. Passing on hills, curves or at intersections is unlawful unless at least two lanes go in your direction. Passing a stopped school bus loading or unloading is also prohibited, subject to the roadway-separation exception [FXsec07R10].
Why it matters: group passing-rules; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec07-F12, sec07-F13 [FXsec07R10].
Source: [FXsec07R10 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec07-R11 | anchor: FXsec07R11
Do not pass on hills or curves, or at intersections or railway crossings, except where at least two lanes run in your direction. Finish overtaking before reaching a No Passing zone [FXsec07R11].
Why it matters: group passing-rules; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec07-F13, sec07-F14 [FXsec07R11].
